title: Codec Tokenizer Map
description: Client-side decode table for a single model's token vocabulary. Given a token ID, returns the string fragment it represents.

id.description: Stable, globally unique tokenizer identifier (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6-v1'). Matches the tokenizer_id in the READY frame.

version.description: Semver map version. Incremented when the vocabulary changes without a model rename.

vocab_size.description: Total number of token IDs in the vocabulary. Valid IDs are 0 … vocab_size-1.

tokens.description: Map of token_id (string) → decoded fragment (string). String keys because JSON objects require string keys.

special_tokens.description: Named special token IDs (e.g. 'end_of_turn', 'pad', 'bos', 'eos'). Clients should not render special tokens as text.

byte_fallback_start.description: First token ID in the byte-fallback range (inclusive). IDs in [byte_fallback_start, byte_fallback_end] represent single UTF-8 bytes.

byte_fallback_end.description: Last token ID in the byte-fallback range (inclusive).

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this map was published. Informational only.
